jobs.title: Head of Procurement Ingredients
jobs.description:
Join us and celebrate the beauty of human experience. Create for happier, healthier lives, with love for nature. Together, with kindness and humility, we deliver food innovations, craft inspired fragrances and develop beauty and wellbeing solutions that make people look and feel good. There’s much to learn and many to learn from, with more than 17,000 employees around the world to explore ideas and ambitions with. Dive into varied, flexible, and stimulating environments. Meet empowered professionals to partner with, befriend, and stretch your skills alongside. Every day, your energy, your creativity, and your determination will shape our future, making a positive difference on billions of people. Every essence of you enriches our world. We are Givaudan. Human by nature.

## Head of Procurement Ingredients - Your future position?

You will require to establish a clear segment vision with focus on value creation and bottom line – aligned with the current strategy goals and targets. You will develop and implement category strategies to achieve sustainable reductions in spend aligned with Division strategies. Actively engage and represent Procurement with key segment stakeholders. You will also operate in close collaboration with Operations, Supply Chain, Commercial Organization, GBS and the respective business partners. Lead & develop CatMan teams.

**Location**Vernier or Shanghai

**Reporting to**Deputy Head of Procurement F&B

## In this exciting role, you will be responsible for

## Alignment of Strategies

- Establish joint commitments with a clear focus on business impact & winning with customers
- Develop/validate the annual Procurement Plan and budget within the segment. Agree priorities, sourcing strategies and timelines with stakeholders
- Create a vision that consistently delivers value to the segment through our Procurement current strategy of Competitive Advantage, Resilient Supply Chain and Sustainability.
- Actively support the responsible sourcing, sourcing4good project and the Scope 3 reduction journey.

## Partnership

- Represent the segment Procurement Categories in business review meetings as appropriate. Ensure information flow between the related segment and the Procurement Category management organization to effectively deliver against business/functional strategies
- Participate in the Global S&OP for Ingredients and work closely with Global Procurement Management/Supply Chain Management /Pricing heads/Ingredients Manufacturing Management.
- Proactively communicate relevant decisions and market trends, and inform about potential RM issues
- Establish a stakeholder engagement plan
- Fosters strong relationships with key suppliers within the segment in alignment with the strategy

## Sourcing Strategy

- Drive the development and implementation of category strategies aligned with the global Procurement strategy
- Monitor achievements against business goals and periodically reassess the targets.
- Promote Market Intelligence

## Portfolio Management

- Negotiate contracts and manage vendor partnerships globally
- Identify opportunities for portfolio optimization and actively involve creation and manufacturing in development of optimization plans
- Own key supplier relationship, and lead key supplier conflict resolutions
- Ensure adequate contract cover for materials and supplier compliance to contracts
- Ensure vendor performance at target levels
- 20-50% travel required

## People Management

- Build and develop a global category management organization
- Lead & develop the Category Managers in your team – on sourcing strategy, priority setting and communication to relevant stakeholder and resource optimization
- Attract and train the necessary talent to build a distinctive organization
- Develop a strong succession plan and promote high potentials and address performance gaps

## Your professional profile includes

- More than 10-15 years’ of experience in Procurement/Commercial and/or OPS organisations
- Experience in Operations Management and/or acting as a Chemist in a chemical plant is preferred.
- Experience in managing global teams from diverse backgrounds.
- Knowledge of F&F/FMCG/Chemical industry
- Specific and intense technical and market knowledge in the respective segment
- Knowledge in the Fragrance and Flavours, FMCG or Chemical industry
- Excellent negotiation and communication skills
- Cultural awareness and used to work with fast-changing requirements

## Our Benefits

- Attractive package with benefits
- Excellent opportunities for progressive learning and development
- A creative team environment that will inspire you

*LI-Y

At Givaudan, you contribute to delightful taste and scent experiences that touch people’s lives.

We value the different perspectives that come from diverse cultures, backgrounds, and experiences.

Everyone — regardless of race, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, culture, religion, or any personal circumstances — is warmly welcomed at Givaudan, a place where we all love to be and grow.

Every essence of you enriches our world. Join us in making a difference together.

Incontra professionisti abilitati a collaborare con, fare amicizia, e allungare le tue abilità insieme. Ogni giorno, la vostra energia, la vostra creatività e la vostra determinazione plasmano il nostro futuro, facendo una differenza positiva su miliardi di persone. Ogni vostra essenza arricchisce il nostro mondo. Siamo Givaudan. Umano per natura. Head of Procurement Ingredients - La vostra posizione futura? Dovrete stabilire una chiara visione del segmento con attenzione alla creazione di valore e alla linea di fondo – allineati con gli obiettivi e gli obiettivi di strategia attuali. Svilupperai e implementerai strategie di categoria per ottenere riduzioni sostenibili nella spesa allineate alle strategie della Divisione. Attivamente impegnarsi e rappresentare il Procurement con gli stakeholder del segmento chiave. Potrai anche operare in stretta collaborazione con Operazioni, Supply Chain, Organizzazione Commerciale, GBS e i rispettivi partner commerciali. Lead & sviluppare team CatMan. LocationVernier o Shanghai Reporting toDeputy Head of Procurement F&B In questo ruolo emozionante, sarete responsabili per l'allineamento delle strategie - Stabilire impegni congiunti con una chiara focalizzazione sull'impatto aziendale e la vincita con i clienti - Sviluppare / aggiornare il piano annuale di approvvigionamento e il budget all'interno del segmento. Le priorità concordate, le strategie di approvvigionamento e le linee temporali con gli stakeholder - Creare una visione che fornisce costantemente valore al segmento attraverso la nostra strategia corrente di approvvigionamento di vantaggio competitivo, catena di approvvigionamento affidabile e sostenibilità. - Supporta attivamente il progetto responsabile di sourcing, sourcing4good e il viaggio di riduzione Scope 3. Partenariato - Rappresentare il segmento Categorie di appalti nelle riunioni di revisione aziendale come appropriato. Assicurare il flusso di informazioni tra il segmento relativo e l'organizzazione di gestione della Categoria di approvvigionamento per fornire efficacemente contro le strategie aziendali / funzionali - Partecipare nel Global S&OP per gli ingredienti e lavorare a stretto contatto con Global Procurement Management / Gestione delle catene di approvvigionamento /Pricing heads/Ingredients Manufacturing Management. - Comunicare attivamente le decisioni e le tendenze del mercato pertinenti e informare sui potenziali problemi RM - Stabilire un piano di coinvolgimento degli stakeholder - Promuove forti relazioni con i fornitori chiave all'interno del segmento in allineamento con la strategia Sourcing Strategy - Guidare lo sviluppo e l'implementazione di strategie di categoria allineate con la strategia globale Procurement - Monitorare i risultati contro gli obiettivi aziendali e rivaluta periodicamente gli obiettivi. - Promuovere la gestione del portafoglio - Negoziare contratti e gestire partnership dei fornitori a livello globale - Identificare opportunità per l'ottimizzazione del portafoglio e coinvolgere attivamente la creazione e la produzione nello sviluppo di piani di ottimizzazione - Proprio rapporto fornitore chiave, e piombo soluzioni di conflitto fornitore chiave - Assicurare una copertura contrattuale adeguata per i materiali e la conformità dei fornitori ai contratti - Assicurare prestazioni del fornitore a livelli target - 20-50% di viaggio richiesto People Management - Costruire e sviluppare una strategia globale di gestione delle categorie - Esperienza nella gestione di team globali da diversi background. - Conoscenza del settore F&F/FMCG/Chemical - Conoscenza tecnica e di mercato specifica e intensa nel rispettivo segmento - Conoscenza nella Fragranza e nei Flavours, nell’industria FMCG o chimica - Ottimi metodi di negoziazione e di comunicazione - Consapevolezza culturale e utilizzata per lavorare con requisiti in rapida evoluzione I nostri vantaggi - Pacchetto attraente con benefici - Ottime opportunità per l’apprendimento progressivo e lo sviluppo - Un ambiente di team creativo che ti ispirerà *LI- Apprezziamo le diverse prospettive che provengono da diverse culture, sfondi ed esperienze. Tutti — indipendentemente dalla razza, dall'identità di genere, dall'orientamento sessuale, dall'età, dalla disabilità, dalla cultura, dalla religione o da qualsiasi circostanza personale — sono accolti calorosamente a Givaudan, un luogo dove tutti amiamo essere e crescere. Ogni vostra essenza arricchisce il nostro mondo. Unisciti a noi per fare la differenza insieme.

jobs.description:
Join us and celebrate the beauty of human experience. Create for happier, healthier lives, with love for nature. Together, with kindness, humility, and a spirit of adventure, we deliver food innovations, craft inspired fragrances and develop beauty and wellbeing solutions. There’s much to learn from our 79 production sites worldwide, known for their best-in-class processes and procedures. There’s many to learn from, with high-performing leaders and caring colleagues to explore ideas and ambitions with. Every day, your energy, your personality, and your determination will shape our future, making a positive difference on billions of people. Every essence of you enriches our world. We are Givaudan. Human by nature.

## Talent Pool - Operations Internship (m/f/d)

We are looking for dedicated interns who want to put their passion for food science and engineering into practice. At Givaudan, you have the opportunity to participate in projects that challenge your skills and foster your creativity. You will work in an environment where you help develop novel solutions that meet our customers’ needs.

During your internship, you will gain valuable insights into different departments within Givaudan’s Operations functions (Production, Supply Chain, Logistics & Shipping, Plant Maintenance, Engineering, Quality and Process Technology) at our sites in Zurich. We offer you the chance to bring in your ideas and work together with experienced professionals on solutions that make a difference.

## Requirements

- Students preferably in the 3rd year of a Bachelor's program or recently graduated in food science, food technology, chemical engineering, biotechnology or a comparable discipline at ETH.
- Availability for a minimum internship duration of 6 months
- Fluent English, additional languages are an advantage
- Enthusiastic about food science and engineering
- Team player, but also able to work independently
- Professional in communication at different levels

## Additional benefits we offer

- Interesting development opportunities
- Flexible working hours
- Additional paid days off
- Favourable pension fund conditions
- Discounted meals in the staff restaurant
- Sports and leisure activities in the Givaudan sports club
- Discount in the staff shop in Kemptthal
- Free company car park
- Worldwide private accident cover and free choice of hospital
- Additional voluntary family and education allowances

If you have a true passion for food science and consumer products and love staying ahead of the curve, submit your CV and Cover Letter in English. Create your profile today and apply now to be part of our Talent Pool. Your profile will be regularly reviewed against open vacancies. If there is a match, our talent advisor will reach out to you to introduce and explore the opportunity for future collaboration.

At Givaudan, you contribute to delightful taste and scent experiences that touch people’s lives. You work within an inspiring teamwork culture – where you can thrive, collaborate and learn from other talented and passionate people across disciplines, regions and divisions. Every essence of you enriches our world. Givaudan is committed to equal opportunities. Therefore, we welcome applications regardless of cultural and social background, gender, age, religion or sexual identity. We also have a safe working environment, progressive working conditions and are certified as an equal pay employer.

• Cerchiamo stagisti dedicati che vogliano mettere in pratica la loro passione per la scienza e l'ingegneria alimentare. In Givaudan hai l'opportunità di partecipare a progetti che mettono alla prova le tue capacità e promuovono la tua creatività. jobs.description:
Join us and celebrate the beauty of human experience. Create for happier, healthier lives, with love for nature. Together, with kindness and humility, we deliver food innovations, craft inspired fragrances and develop beauty and wellbeing solutions that make people look and feel good. There’s much to learn and many to learn from, with more than 16,000 employees around the world to explore ideas and ambitions with. Dive into varied, flexible, and stimulating environments. Meet empowered professionals to partner with, befriend, and stretch your skills alongside. Every day, your energy, your creativity, and your determination will shape our future, making a positive difference on billions of people. Every essence of you enriches our world. We are Givaudan. Human by nature.

## Product Manager and Designer – SAP Treasury - Your future role?

As a Product Manager and Designer – SAP Treasury, you will oversee the development and performance of the treasury digital product and capabilities. You will coordinate and lead the team to deliver an innovative and high-quality product. This product will be aligned with the digital strategy for the function and the company. It will meet the needs of users while maintaining a close relationship with them, including existing and potential users.

You will report to the Finance and Controlling Product Line Manager.

## Your main responsibilities

*Purpose*

- Accountable for the Treasury digital product strategy, roadmap definition and communication.
- Maximize value delivered through the product
- Lead the Product team delivering on this product

*Core Responsibilities*

- Lead and communicate the vision, ambition and product roadmap with the right Business and IT partners
- Collaborate with other IT products managers to ensure alignments in deliveries
- Prioritize the product backlog and define important metrics.
- Identify and support innovation opportunities related to Treasury
- Oversee product releases; adoption and measure / improve outcome realization.
- Ensure understanding of the team execution with the product strategy and roadmap
- Promote user experience, communication and change practices applicable to the product.

*Product Management and Delivery*

- Define and oversee the Treasury digital product vision, roadmap and product backlog.
- Guide the team through the product discovery process to execution and delivery, aligned with the product vision and roadmap.
- Prioritize and take decisions regarding the digital product capabilities, including features and technology upgrades.
- Collaborate the team delivers needs / impacts from other product projects.
- Identify & escalate staffing needs for the product team, cross-product teams, functional partners and vendor partners.
- Encourage / Develop an outcome-centric mindset, to measure success and progress while promoting and ensuring maximum adoption of the product.
- Ensure the product is built in accordance to architecture standards, information security, GDPR, other policies and with a data by design approach.
- Provide SAP designs, customizing, testing, delivery and post implementation support including troubleshooting to end users across many countries.
- Provide functional specifications for developers.
- Deliver project plans to business stakeholders.
- Organize, lead, and always improve our capacity to develop digital solutions with a product mindset.
- Support the Finance and Controlling Product Line Manager in team member recruitment and onboarding. Coach in developing product team members by upskilling and reskilling them

## You have

- Bachelor's degree in computer engineering or business school or equivalent
- 10+ years working in IT environment or global IT projects
- 5+ years as a Product Manager or lead position
- 5+ years on SAP FI/FSCM/Treasury hands-on experience as functional/application designer in and 3rd party interfaces (e.g banks and government institutions) and basic FICO knowledge.
- Experience with end-to-end payment processes in SAP, including understanding of Payment configuration, SAP DMEEs, bank connectivity and transport management across system landscapes.
- Customizing experience in TRM and IHC.
- 2+ years in Business Process Design / Modelling
- Experience in workshop animation (design sprints, design thinking)
- 2+ years of experience managing team dynamics, building team relationships, mentoring team members, and delivering feedback

## Our benefits

- Healthcare support
- Retirement plan
- Career development
- Bonus payment

Multiple locations Ashford (UK), Argenteuil (France), Avignon (France), Budapest (Hungary), Kemptthal (Switzerland), Vernier (Switzerland)

Le tue principali responsabilità *Scopo* - Responsabile della strategia di prodotto digitale del Tesoro, della definizione della roadmap e della comunicazione. - Massimizzare il valore fornito attraverso il prodotto - Guidare il team di prodotto che fornisce questo prodotto *Responsabilità principali* - Guidare e comunicare la visione, l'ambizione e la roadmap del prodotto con i giusti partner aziendali e IT - Collaborare con altri responsabili dei prodotti IT per garantire allineamenti nelle consegne - Dare priorità al backlog del prodotto e definire metriche importanti. - Identificare e supportare opportunità di innovazione legate alla Tesoreria - Supervisionare i rilasci dei prodotti; adozione e misurazione/miglioramento della realizzazione dei risultati. - Garantire la comprensione dell'esecuzione del team con la strategia del prodotto e la roadmap. - Promuovere l'esperienza dell'utente, la comunicazione e le pratiche di cambiamento applicabili al prodotto. *Gestione e consegna del prodotto* - Definire e supervisionare la visione del prodotto digitale, la roadmap e il backlog del prodotto del Tesoro. - Guidare il team attraverso il processo di scoperta del prodotto fino all'esecuzione e alla consegna, in linea con la visione del prodotto e la roadmap. - Stabilire le priorità e prendere decisioni riguardanti le capacità del prodotto digitale, comprese funzionalità e aggiornamenti tecnologici. - Collaborare con il team per fornire esigenze / impatti da altri progetti di prodotto. - Identificare e intensificare le esigenze di personale per il team di prodotto, i team interprodotto, i partner funzionali e i partner fornitori. - Incoraggiare / sviluppare una mentalità incentrata sui risultati, per misurare il successo e il progresso promuovendo e garantendo la massima adozione del prodotto. - Garantire che il prodotto sia costruito in conformità con gli standard di architettura, sicurezza delle informazioni, GDPR, altre politiche e con un approccio data by design. - Fornire progettazione SAP, personalizzazione, test, consegna e supporto post-implementazione, inclusa la risoluzione dei problemi, agli utenti finali in molti paesi. - Fornire specifiche funzionali per gli sviluppatori. - Fornire piani di progetto alle parti interessate aziendali. - Organizzare, guidare e migliorare sempre la nostra capacità di sviluppare soluzioni digitali con una mentalità di prodotto. - Supportare il responsabile della linea di prodotti Finanza e controllo nel reclutamento e nell'onboarding dei membri del team. Coach nello sviluppo dei membri del team di prodotto aggiornandoli e riqualificandoli Hai: - Laurea in ingegneria informatica o business school o equivalente - 10+ anni di lavoro in ambiente IT o progetti IT globali - 5+ anni come Product Manager o posizione di leadership - 5+ anni di esperienza pratica su SAP FI/FSCM/Tesoreria come progettista funzionale/applicativo in interfacce di terze parti (ad esempio banche e istituzioni governative) e conoscenza di base di FICO. - Esperienza con i processi di pagamento end-to-end in SAP, inclusa la comprensione della configurazione dei pagamenti, dei DMEE SAP, della connettività bancaria e della gestione dei trasporti attraverso gli scenari di sistema. - Esperienza di personalizzazione in TRM e IHC. - Oltre 2 anni di progettazione/modellazione dei processi aziendali - Esperienza nell'animazione di workshop (sprint di progettazione, design thinking) - Oltre 2 anni di esperienza nella gestione delle dinamiche di team, nella creazione di relazioni di gruppo, nel tutoraggio dei membri del team e nella fornitura di feedback I nostri vantaggi - Supporto sanitario - Piano pensionistico - Sviluppo di carriera - Pagamento di bonus Sedi multiple Ashford (Regno Unito), Argenteuil (Francia), Avignone (Francia), Budapest (Ungheria), Kemptthal (Svizzera), Vernier (Svizzera) At Givaudan, contribuisci a deliziose esperienze di gusto e profumo che toccano la vita delle persone. Lavori all'interno di una cultura del lavoro di squadra stimolante, dove puoi prosperare, collaborare e imparare da altre persone talentuose e appassionate in tutte le discipline, regioni e divisioni. Ogni tua essenza arricchisce il nostro mondo. Givaudan si impegna a favore delle pari opportunità. Pertanto, accogliamo con favore le candidature indipendentemente dal background culturale e sociale, dal sesso, dall'età, dalla religione o dall'identità sessuale. Disponiamo inoltre di un ambiente di lavoro sicuro, di condizioni di lavoro progressiste e siamo certificati come datore di lavoro che garantisce la parità di retribuzione.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Join us and celebrate the beauty of human experience. Create for happier, healthier lives, with love for nature. Together, with kindness and humility, we deliver food innovations, craft inspired fragrances and develop beauty and wellbeing solutions that make people look and feel good. There’s much to learn and many to learn from, with more than 16,000 employees around the world to explore ideas and ambitions with. Dive into varied, flexible, and stimulating environments. Meet empowered professionals to partner with, befriend, and stretch your skills alongside. Every day, your energy, your creativity, and your determination will shape our future, making a positive difference on billions of people. Every essence of you enriches our world. We are Givaudan. Human by nature. ## Product Manager and Designer – SAP Treasury - Your future role? As a Product Manager and Designer – SAP Treasury, you will oversee the development and performance of the treasury digital product and capabilities. You will coordinate and lead the team to deliver an innovative and high-quality product. This product will be aligned with the digital strategy for the function and the company. It will meet the needs of users while maintaining a close relationship with them, including existing and potential users. You will report to the Finance and Controlling Product Line Manager. ## Your main responsibilities *Purpose* - Accountable for the Treasury digital product strategy, roadmap definition and communication. - Maximize value delivered through the product - Lead the Product team delivering on this product *Core 
• Responsibilities* - Lead and communicate the vision, ambition and product roadmap with the right Business and IT partners - Collaborate with other IT products managers to ensure alignments in deliveries - Prioritize the product backlog and define important metrics. - Identify and support innovation opportunities related to Treasury - Oversee product releases; adoption and measure / improve outcome realization. - Ensure understanding of the team execution with the product strategy and roadmap - Promote user experience, communication and change practices applicable to the product. *Product Management and Delivery* - Define and oversee the Treasury digital product vision, roadmap and product backlog. - Guide the team through the product discovery process to execution and delivery, aligned with the product vision and roadmap. - Prioritize and take decisions regarding the digital product capabilities, including features and technology upgrades. - Collaborate the team delivers needs / impacts from other product projects. - Identify & escalate staffing needs for the product team, cross-product teams, functional partners and vendor partners. - Encourage / Develop an outcome-centric mindset, to measure success and progress while promoting and ensuring maximum adoption of the product. - Ensure the product is built in accordance to architecture standards, information security, GDPR, other policies and with a data by design approach. - Provide SAP designs, customizing, testing, delivery and post implementation support including troubleshooting to end users across many countries. - Provide functional specifications for developers. - Deliver project plans to business stakeholders. - Organize, lead, and always improve our capacity to develop digital solutions with a product mindset. - Support the Finance and Controlling Product Line Manager in team member recruitment and onboarding. Coach in developing product team members by upskilling and reskilling them ## You have - Bachelor's degree in computer engineering or business school or equivalent - 10+ years working in IT environment or global IT projects - 5+ years as a Product Manager or lead position - 5+ years on SAP FI/FSCM/Treasury hands-on experience as functional/application designer in and 3rd party interfaces (e.g banks and government institutions) and basic FICO knowledge. - Experience with end-to-end payment processes in SAP, including understanding of Payment configuration, SAP DMEEs, bank connectivity and transport management across system landscapes. - Customizing experience in TRM and IHC. - 2+ years in Business Process Design / Modelling - Experience in workshop animation (design sprints, design thinking) - 2+ years of experience managing team dynamics, building team relationships, mentoring team members, and delivering feedback ## Our benefits - Healthcare support - Retirement plan - Career development - Bonus payment Multiple locations Ashford (UK), Argenteuil (France), Avignon (France), Budapest (Hungary), Kemptthal (Switzerland), Vernier (Switzerland) At Givaudan, you contribute to delightful taste and scent experiences that touch people’s lives. You work within an inspiring teamwork culture – where you can thrive, collaborate and learn from other talented and passionate people across disciplines, regions and divisions. Every essence of you enriches our world. Givaudan is committed to equal opportunities. Therefore, we welcome applications regardless of cultural and social background, gender, age, religion or sexual identity. We also have a safe working environment, progressive working conditions and are certified as an equal pay employer.

Ermutigen / Entwickeln Sie eine ergebnisorientierte Denkweise, um Erfolg und Fortschritt zu messen und gleichzeitig die maximale Akzeptanz des Produkts zu fördern und sicherzustellen. - Sicherstellen, dass das Produkt in Übereinstimmung mit Architekturstandards, Informationssicherheit, DSGVO, anderen Richtlinien und mit einem Data-by-Design-Ansatz erstellt wird. Bereitstellung von SAP-Designs, Customizing, Testing, Delivery und Post-Implementierungs-Support einschließlich Fehlerbehebung für Endbenutzer in vielen Ländern. - Bereitstellung funktionaler Spezifikationen für Entwickler. - Bereitstellung von Projektplänen für Unternehmensbeteiligte. Unterstützen Sie den Finance and Controlling Product Line Manager bei der Rekrutierung und dem Onboarding von Teammitgliedern. Coach bei der Entwicklung von Produktteammitgliedern durch Upskilling und Reskilling Sie haben - Bachelor-Abschluss in Computer Engineering oder Business School oder gleichwertig - 10+ Jahre Arbeit in IT-Umgebung oder globalen IT-Projekten - 5+ Jahre als Produktmanager oder leitende Position - 5+ Jahre SAP FI / FSM / Treasury praktische Erfahrung als Funktions- / Anwendungsdesigner in und 3rd Party-Schnittstellen (zB Banken und Regierungsinstitutionen) und grundlegende FICO-Kenntnisse. - Erfahrung mit End-to-End-Zahlungsprozessen in SAP, einschließlich Verständnis der Zahlungskonfiguration, SAP DMEEs, Bankverbindung und Transportmanagement in Systemlandschaften. - Customizing Erfahrung in TRM und IHC. - 2+ Jahre in Business Process Design / Modelling - Erfahrung in der Animation von Workshops (Design Sprints, Design Thinking) - 2+ Jahre Erfahrung im Management von Teamdynamik, Aufbau von Teambeziehungen, Mentoring von Teammitgliedern und Bereitstellung von Feedback Unsere Vorteile - Gesundheitsunterstützung - Ruhestandsplan - Karriereentwicklung - Bonuszahlung Mehrere Standorte Ashford (UK), Argenteuil (Frankreich), Avignon (Frankreich), Budapest (Ungarn), Kemptthal (Schweiz), Vernier (Schweiz) Bei Givaudan tragen Sie zu herrlichen Geschmacks- und Dufterlebnissen bei, die das Leben der Menschen berühren. Sie arbeiten in einer inspirierenden Teamkultur – in der Sie gedeihen, zusammenarbeiten und von anderen talentierten und leidenschaftlichen Menschen in allen Disziplinen, Regionen und Abteilungen lernen können. Jede Essenz von dir bereichert unsere Welt. Givaudan setzt sich für Chancengleichheit ein. descriptionByLocale.fr: Rejoignez-nous et célébrez la beauté de l'expérience humaine. Créez pour une vie plus heureuse et plus saine, avec amour pour la nature. Ensemble, avec gentillesse et humilité, nous proposons des innovations alimentaires, créons des parfums inspirés et développons des solutions de beauté et de bien-être qui permettent aux gens de se sentir bien. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre et beaucoup à apprendre, avec plus de 16 000 employés dans le monde avec qui explorer des idées et des ambitions. Plongez dans des environnements variés, flexibles et stimulants. Rencontrez des professionnels habilités avec lesquels vous pouvez collaborer, vous lier d'amitié et développer vos compétences. Chaque jour, votre énergie, votre créativité et votre détermination façonneront notre avenir, faisant une différence positive pour des milliards de personnes. Chaque essence de vous enrichit notre monde. Nous sommes Givaudan. Humain par nature. Product Manager et Designer – SAP Treasury - Votre futur rôle ? En tant que chef de produit et concepteur – SAP Treasury, vous superviserez le développement et les performances du produit et des capacités numériques de trésorerie. Vous coordonnerez et dirigerez l’équipe pour livrer un produit innovant et de haute qualité. Ce produit sera aligné sur la stratégie digitale de la fonction et de l'entreprise. Il répondra aux besoins des utilisateurs tout en entretenant une relation étroite avec eux, y compris les utilisateurs existants et potentiels. Vous rapporterez au Product Line Manager Finance et Controlling. Vos principales responsabilités *Objectif* - Responsable de la stratégie des produits numériques de la Trésorerie, de la définition de la feuille de route et de la communication. - Maximiser la valeur fournie par le produit - Diriger l'équipe produit qui réalise ce produit *Responsabilités principales * - Diriger et communiquer la vision, l'ambition et la feuille de route du produit avec les bons partenaires commerciaux et informatiques - Collaborer avec d'autres responsables de produits informatiques pour assurer l'alignement des livraisons - Hiérarchiser le backlog du produit et définir des mesures importantes. - Identifier et soutenir les opportunités d'innovation liées à la trésorerie. - Superviser les sorties de produits ; adoption et mesure/amélioration de la réalisation des résultats. - Assurer la compréhension de l'exécution de l'équipe avec la stratégie produit et la feuille de route - Promouvoir l'expérience utilisateur, la communication et les pratiques de changement applicables au produit. *Gestion et livraison des produits* - Définir et superviser la vision, la feuille de route et le backlog des produits numériques de la Trésorerie. - Guider l'équipe tout au long du processus de découverte de produits jusqu'à leur exécution et leur livraison, conformément à la vision et à la feuille de route du produit. - Hiérarchiser et prendre des décisions concernant les capacités des produits numériques, y compris les fonctionnalités et les mises à niveau technologiques. - Collaborer avec l'équipe pour répondre aux besoins/impacts d'autres projets de produits. - Identifier et faire remonter les besoins en personnel pour l'équipe produit, les équipes multi-produits, les partenaires fonctionnels et les partenaires fournisseurs. - Encourager/Développer un état d'esprit centré sur les résultats, pour mesurer le succès et les progrès tout en promouvant et en assurant une adoption maximale du produit. - S'assurer que le produit est construit conformément aux normes d'architecture, à la sécurité de l'information, au RGPD, à d'autres politiques et avec une approche data by design. - Fournir une assistance en matière de conception, de personnalisation, de test, de livraison et de post-implémentation SAP, y compris le dépannage, aux utilisateurs finaux dans de nombreux pays. - Fournir les spécifications fonctionnelles aux développeurs. - Livrer les plans de projet aux parties prenantes de l'entreprise. - Organiser, diriger et toujours améliorer notre capacité à développer des solutions numériques avec un esprit produit. - Soutenir le responsable de la ligne de produits Finance et Contrôle dans le recrutement et l'intégration des membres de l'équipe. Coacher dans le développement des membres de l'équipe produit en les perfectionnant et en les requalifiant. Vous avez - Un baccalauréat en ingénierie informatique ou en école de commerce ou équivalent - Plus de 10 ans de travail dans un environnement informatique ou des projets informatiques mondiaux - Plus de 5 ans en tant que chef de produit ou poste de direction - Plus de 5 ans d'expérience pratique sur SAP FI/FSCM/Trésorerie en tant que concepteur fonctionnel/d'applications et d'interfaces tierces (par exemple, banques et institutions gouvernementales) et connaissances de base de FICO. - Expérience des processus de paiement de bout en bout dans SAP, y compris la compréhension de la configuration des paiements, des SAP DMEE, de la connectivité bancaire et de la gestion du transport dans les paysages système. - Personnalisation de l'expérience dans TRM et IHC. - 2 ans et plus en conception/modélisation de processus métier - Expérience dans l'animation d'ateliers (design sprints, design thinking) - 2 ans et plus d'expérience dans la gestion de la dynamique d'équipe, l'établissement de relations d'équipe, l'encadrement des membres de l'équipe et la transmission de commentaires Nos avantages - Soutien aux soins de santé - Plan de retraite - Développement de carrière - Paiement de primes Plusieurs sites Ashford (Royaume-Uni), Argenteuil (France), Avignon (France), Budapest (Hongrie), Kemptthal (Suisse), Vernier (Suisse) Chez Givaudan, vous contribuez au goût délicieux et des expériences olfactives qui touchent la vie des gens. Vous travaillez dans une culture de travail d'équipe inspirante, où vous pouvez vous épanouir, collaborer et apprendre auprès d'autres personnes talentueuses et passionnées dans toutes les disciplines, régions et divisions. Chaque essence de vous enrichit notre monde. Givaudan s'engage en faveur de l'égalité des chances. Par conséquent, nous acceptons les candidatures indépendamment de l’origine culturelle et sociale, du sexe, de l’âge, de la religion ou de l’identité sexuelle. Nous bénéficions également d'un environnement de travail sûr, de conditions de travail progressives et sommes certifiés en tant qu'employeur garantissant l'égalité de rémunération.

jobs.title: Betriebselektriker (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Feiere gemeinsam mit uns die Schönheit menschlicher Erfahrungen. Gestalte mit Liebe zur Natur für ein glücklicheres, gesünderes Leben von Menschen. Gemeinsam, mit Herzlichkeit und Bescheidenheit, liefern wir Lebensmittelinnovationen, kreieren inspirierende Düfte und entwickeln Lösungen, mit denen Menschen gut aussehen und sich gut fühlen. Bei mehr als 17.000 Beschäftigten weltweit, die gemeinsam Ideen und Ziele erkunden, gibt es viel zu lernen und viele, von denen wir lernen können. Tauche ein in eine abwechslungsreiche, flexible und anregende Umgebung. Begegne Fachleuten mit echten Befugnissen, mit denen du partnerschaftlich zusammenarbeiten, Freunde finden und deine Fähigkeiten erweitern kannst. Jeden Tag prägen deine Energie, deine Kreativität und deine Entschlossenheit unsere Zukunft und beinflussen Milliarden von Menschen positiv. Jeder Teil von dir ist eine Bereicherung für unsere Welt. Wir sind Givaudan. Human by nature.

Als **Betriebselektriker** (m/w/d) bist Du für die Durchführung von routinemässigen und anspruchsvollen Reparaturen sowie vorbeugenden Wartungen und Installationen von Geräten verantwortlich, um Störungen des Standortbetriebs zu minimieren. Der Arbeitsort ist in Dübendorf, wo wir 24/7 Aromen in flüssiger und pulverförmiger Form herstellen.

Dein neues Team ist bereits neugierig, Dich kennenzulernen.

Hättest Du auch Interesse, in der betriebseigenen Feuerwehr mitzuwirken? Das würde uns sehr freuen!

## In dieser spannenden Position bist Du verantwortlich für

- Durchführung von vorbeugenden Wartungen sowie erweiterter Fehlerbehebung und Reparaturen an Produktions- und Infrastrukturanlagen im Bereich Elektro
- Proaktive Lösung wiederkehrender Wartungsprobleme im zugewiesenen Tätigkeitsbereich
- Erstellung elektrischer Installationen sowie Reparatur und Fehlerbehebung von Motoren, Instrumenten und Steuerungen
- Identifizierung von Abweichungen und Dokumentation/Kommunikation dieser gemäss den Standardarbeitsanweisungen
- Anleitung und Überwachung von Auftragnehmern bei Wartungs- und Installationsprojekten, von der Ankunft bis zum Verlassen der Produktion
- Arbeit in Übereinstimmung mit allen relevanten internen Sicherheits- & Qualitätsanforderungen
- Teilnahme an kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsaktivitäten
- Durchführung von administrativen Aufgaben am Computer und im SAP
- Einsatz in der Basis-, Früh- und Spätschicht sowie im Wochenend-Pikettdienst. Bei Kapazitätsengpässen auch punktuell in der Nachtschicht

## Dein fachliches Profil

- Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im elektronischen Bereich (Elektroinstallateur EFZ) oder einem verwandten Fachbereich mit mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung vorzugsweise im Produktions- oder Anlagenbetrieb
- Betriebselektrikerbewilligung nach Art. 13 NIV oder Bereitschaft diese zu erlangen
- Sicherer Umgang mit Handwerkzeugen und Geräten zur Installation, Demontage und Prüfung von elektronischen Geräten
- Fähigkeit, Elektroschemata zu zeichnen/skizzieren sowie einfache Anweisungen zu schreiben und bereitzustellen
- Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil
- Gültiger Führerausweis (Kategorie B, Auto)

## Welche zusätzlichen Benefits bieten wir an?

- Interessante Entwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
- 40 Stunden Woche
- Zusätzlich bezahlte Freie Tage
- Vorteilhafte Pensionskassen Konditionen
- Ermässigte Verpflegung im Personalrestaurant
- Sport- und Freizeitaktivitäten im Givaudan Sportclub (Duschen vor Ort)
- Rabatt im Mitarbeitershop in Kemptthal
- Gratis Firmenparkplatz und Bike Badge
- REKA Checks und SBB Halbtax beteiligung
- Weltweite private Unfalldeckung und freie Spitalwahl
- Zusätzliche Freiwillige Familien- und Ausbildungszulagen

Bei Givaudan trägst du dazu bei, köstliche Geschmacks- und Dufterlebnisse zu schaffen, die das Leben der Menschen bereichern. Wir schätzen die unterschiedlichen Perspektiven, die aus vielfältigen Kulturen, Hintergründen und Erfahrungen entstehen. Jede Person – unabhängig von ethnischer Herkunft, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Behinderung, Kultur, Religion oder persönlichen Lebensumständen – ist bei Givaudan herzlich willkommen, einem Ort, an dem wir alle gerne sind und wachsen.

Jeder Teil von dir ist eine Bereicherung für unsere Welt. Mach mit und gestalte gemeinsam mit uns eine bessere Zukunft.

descriptionByLocale.it: Festeggia con noi la bellezza delle esperienze umane. Crea con amore per la natura per una vita più felice e più sana delle persone. Insieme, con calore e modestia, forniamo innovazioni alimentari, creiamo profumi ispiranti e sviluppiamo soluzioni che fanno sembrare le persone e si sentono bene. Con più di 17.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo che esplorano insieme idee e obiettivi, c'è molto da imparare e molti da imparare. Immergetevi in un ambiente vario, flessibile e stimolante. Incontra professionisti con poteri reali che è possibile partner con, fare amici, e espandere le vostre abilità. Ogni giorno, la vostra energia, creatività e determinazione plasmano il nostro futuro e influenzano positivamente miliardi di persone. Ogni parte di voi è un arricchimento per il nostro mondo. Siamo Givaudan. Umano per natura. In qualità di elettricista aziendale (m/f/d), sei responsabile per l'esecuzione di riparazioni di routine e impegnative, nonché per la manutenzione preventiva e l'installazione di attrezzature al fine di ridurre al minimo le interruzioni alle operazioni del sito. Il luogo di lavoro è a Dübendorf, dove produciamo sapori in liquido e polvere forma 24/7. La tua nuova squadra è già curiosa di conoscerti. Ti interesseresti anche a partecipare al reparto antincendio dell’azienda? Saremmo molto soddisfatti di questo! In questa eccitante posizione, si è responsabili per - l'attuazione di manutenzione preventiva, nonché la risoluzione avanzata dei problemi e delle riparazioni su impianti di produzione e infrastrutture nel settore elettrico - la soluzione attiva di problemi di manutenzione ricorrenti nell'area di attività assegnata - la creazione di impianti elettrici, nonché la riparazione e la risoluzione dei problemi di motori, strumenti e controlli - l'identificazione di deviazioni e documentazione/comunicazione di questi secondo le procedure operative standard - l'orientamento e il monitoraggio di manutenzione degli appaltatori In caso di strozzature di capacità, il vostro profilo professionale - Completata formazione professionale nel settore elettronico (installatore elettrico EFZ) o una relativa area specializzata con almeno 3 anni di esperienza professionale preferibilmente nella produzione o nel funzionamento dell'impianto - permesso elettrico aziendale secondo il tipo. 13 NIV o volontà di ottenere questo - Utilizzo sicuro di utensili manuali e attrezzature per l'installazione, smontaggio e collaudo di apparecchiature elettroniche - Capacità di disegnare/sketch diagrammi elettrici, nonché semplici istruzioni per scrivere e fornire - Flusso delle competenze linguistiche tedesche nelle parole e nella scrittura, le competenze in inglese sono vantaggiose - Licenza di guida valida (categoria B, auto) Quali vantaggi aggiuntivi offriamo? - Interessanti opportunità di sviluppo e di formazione - 40 ore settimanali - Ulteriori giorni di riposo - Prestiti vantaggiosi Condizioni - Sconti nel ristorante del personale - Attività sportive e ricreative nel Givaudan Sports Club (doccia sul posto) - Sconto nel negozio di dipendenti a Kemptthal - Parcheggio gratuito della società e badge bici - REKA controlli e partecipazione della SBB mezza quota - Copertura incidente privato in tutto il mondo e scelta gratuita dell'ospedale - Ulteriori indennità volontarie di formazione A Givaudan, aiuta a creare deliziosi sapori e fragranze esperienze che arricchiscono la vita delle persone. Apprezziamo le diverse prospettive che emergono da diverse culture, sfondi ed esperienze. Ogni persona – indipendentemente dall'etnia, dall'identità di genere, dall'orientamento sessuale, dall'età, dalla disabilità, dalla cultura, dalla religione o dalle circostanze personali – è il benvenuto a Givaudan, un luogo dove tutti noi apprezziamo essere e crescere. Ogni parte di voi è un arricchimento per il nostro mondo. Unisciti a noi e costruisci un futuro migliore insieme a noi.
descriptionByLocale.en: Celebrate with us the beauty of human experiences. Create with love for nature for a happier, healthier life of people. Together, with warmth and modesty, we deliver food innovations, create inspiring fragrances and develop solutions that make people look and feel good. With more than 17,000 employees worldwide exploring ideas and goals together, there is much to learn and many to learn from. Immerse yourself in a varied, flexible and stimulating environment. Meet professionals with real powers that you can partner with, make friends, and expand your skills. Every day, your energy, creativity and determination shape our future and positively impact billions of people. Every part of you is an enrichment to our world. We are Givaudan. Human by nature. As a company electrician (m/f/d), you are responsible for carrying out routine and demanding repairs as well as preventive maintenance and installation of equipment in order to minimize disruptions to site operations. The place of work is in Dübendorf, where we produce flavors in liquid and powder form 24/7. Your new team is already curious to meet you. Would you also be interested in participating in the company’s own fire department? We would be very pleased about that! In this exciting position, you are responsible for - implementation of preventive maintenance as well as advanced troubleshooting and repairs on production and infrastructure facilities in the area of electrical - Proactive solution of recurring maintenance problems in the assigned area of activity - Creation of electrical installations as well as repair and troubleshooting of motors, instruments and controls - Identification of deviations and documentation/communication of these according to the standard operating procedures - Guidance and monitoring of contractors in maintenance and installation projects, from arrival to exit of production - Work in accordance with all relevant internal safety & quality requirements - Participation in continuous improvement activities - Implementation of administrative tasks on the computer and in SAP - Use in the basic, early and late shift as well as in the weekend pikett service. In the case of capacity bottlenecks, your professional profile - Completed vocational training in the electronic sector (electrical installer EFZ) or a related specialist area with at least 3 years of professional experience preferably in production or plant operation - company electrician permit according to type. 13 NIV or willingness to obtain this - Safe use of hand tools and equipment for installation, disassembly and testing of electronic equipment - Ability to draw/sketch electrical diagrams as well as simple instructions to write and provide - Flowing German language skills in words and writing, English skills are advantageous - Valid driving licence (category B, car) What additional benefits do we offer? - Interesting development and further education opportunities - 40 hours week - Additional paid days off - Advantageous pension funds Conditions - Discounts in the staff restaurant - Sports and leisure activities in the Givaudan Sports Club (on-site showers) - Discount in the employee shop in Kemptthal - Free company parking and bike badge - REKA checks and SBB half-tax participation - Worldwide private accident coverage and free hospital choice - Additional volunteer family and training allowances At Givaudan, you help create delicious taste and fragrance experiences that enrich people’s lives. We value the different perspectives that emerge from diverse cultures, backgrounds and experiences. Every person – regardless of ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, culture, religion or personal circumstances – is welcome at Givaudan, a place where we all enjoy being and growing. Every part of you is an enrichment to our world. Join us and build a better future together with us.
descriptionByLocale.de:

Bei mehr als 17.000 Beschäftigten weltweit, die gemeinsam Ideen und Ziele erkunden, gibt es viel zu lernen und viele, von denen wir lernen können. Tauche ein in eine abwechslungsreiche, flexible und anregende Umgebung. Begegne Fachleuten mit echten Befugnissen, mit denen du partnerschaftlich zusammenarbeiten, Freunde finden und deine Fähigkeiten erweitern kannst. Jeden Tag prägen deine Energie, deine Kreativität und deine Entschlossenheit unsere Zukunft und beinflussen Milliarden von Menschen positiv. Jeder Teil von dir ist eine Bereicherung für unsere Welt. Wir sind Givaudan. Human by nature. Als **Betriebselektriker** (m/w/d) bist Du für die Durchführung von routinemässigen und anspruchsvollen Reparaturen sowie vorbeugenden Wartungen und Installationen von Geräten verantwortlich, um Störungen des Standortbetriebs zu minimieren. Der Arbeitsort ist in Dübendorf, wo wir 24/7 Aromen in flüssiger und pulverförmiger Form herstellen. Dein neues Team ist bereits neugierig, Dich kennenzulernen. Hättest Du auch Interesse, in der betriebseigenen Feuerwehr mitzuwirken? Das würde uns sehr freuen! ## In dieser spannenden Position bist Du verantwortlich für - Durchführung von vorbeugenden Wartungen sowie erweiterter Fehlerbehebung und Reparaturen an Produktions- und Infrastrukturanlagen im Bereich Elektro - Proaktive Lösung wiederkehrender Wartungsprobleme im zugewiesenen Tätigkeitsbereich - Erstellung elektrischer Installationen sowie Reparatur und Fehlerbehebung von Motoren, Instrumenten und Steuerungen - Identifizierung von Abweichungen und Dokumentation/Kommunikation dieser gemäss den Standardarbeitsanweisungen - Anleitung und Überwachung von Auftragnehmern bei Wartungs- und Installationsprojekten, von der Ankunft bis zum Verlassen der Produktion - Arbeit in Übereinstimmung mit allen relevanten internen Sicherheits- & Qualitätsanforderungen - Teilnahme an kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsaktivitäten - Durchführung von administrativen 
• Aufgaben am Computer und im SAP - Einsatz in der Basis-, Früh- und Spätschicht sowie im Wochenend-Pikettdienst. Bei Kapazitätsengpässen auch punktuell in der Nachtschicht ## Dein fachliches Profil - Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im elektronischen Bereich (Elektroinstallateur EFZ) oder einem verwandten Fachbereich mit mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung vorzugsweise im Produktions- oder Anlagenbetrieb - Betriebselektrikerbewilligung nach Art. 13 NIV oder Bereitschaft diese zu erlangen - Sicherer Umgang mit Handwerkzeugen und Geräten zur Installation, Demontage und Prüfung von elektronischen Geräten - Fähigkeit, Elektroschemata zu zeichnen/skizzieren sowie einfache Anweisungen zu schreiben und bereitzustellen - Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil - Gültiger Führerausweis (Kategorie B, Auto) ## Welche zusätzlichen Benefits bieten wir an? - Interessante Entwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten - 40 Stunden Woche - Zusätzlich bezahlte Freie Tage - Vorteilhafte Pensionskassen Konditionen - Ermässigte Verpflegung im Personalrestaurant - Sport- und Freizeitaktivitäten im Givaudan Sportclub (Duschen vor Ort) - Rabatt im Mitarbeitershop in Kemptthal - Gratis Firmenparkplatz und Bike Badge - REKA Checks und SBB Halbtax beteiligung - Weltweite private Unfalldeckung und freie Spitalwahl - Zusätzliche Freiwillige Familien- und Ausbildungszulagen Bei Givaudan trägst du dazu bei, köstliche Geschmacks- und Dufterlebnisse zu schaffen, die das Leben der Menschen bereichern. Wir schätzen die unterschiedlichen Perspektiven, die aus vielfältigen Kulturen, Hintergründen und Erfahrungen entstehen. Jede Person – unabhängig von ethnischer Herkunft, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Behinderung, Kultur, Religion oder persönlichen Lebensumständen – ist bei Givaudan herzlich willkommen, einem Ort, an dem wir alle gerne sind und wachsen. Jeder Teil von dir ist eine Bereicherung für unsere Welt. Mach mit und gestalte gemeinsam mit uns eine bessere Zukunft.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Célébrez avec nous la beauté des expériences humaines. Créer avec amour pour la nature pour une vie plus heureuse et plus saine des gens. Ensemble, avec chaleur et modestie, nous livrons des innovations alimentaires, créons des parfums inspirants et développons des solutions qui font que les gens regardent et se sentent bien. Avec plus de 17 000 employés à travers le monde qui explorent ensemble des idées et des objectifs, il y a beaucoup à apprendre et beaucoup à apprendre. Plongez-vous dans un environnement varié, flexible et stimulant. Rencontrez des professionnels avec de vrais pouvoirs avec lesquels vous pouvez vous associer, vous faire des amis et développer vos compétences. Chaque jour, votre énergie, votre créativité et votre détermination façonnent notre avenir et affectent positivement des milliards de personnes. Chaque partie de vous est un enrichissement pour notre monde. Nous sommes Givaudan. De nature humaine. En tant qu'électricien d'entreprise (m/f/d), vous êtes responsable des réparations courantes et exigeantes ainsi que de l'entretien préventif et de l'installation de l'équipement afin de minimiser les perturbations aux opérations du site. Le lieu de travail est à Dübendorf, où nous produisons des saveurs sous forme de liquide et de poudre 24/7. Votre nouvelle équipe est déjà curieuse de vous rencontrer. Seriez-vous également intéressé à participer au service des pompiers de l'entreprise? Nous en serions très heureux! Dans cette position passionnante, vous êtes responsable de - la mise en œuvre de l'entretien préventif ainsi que le dépannage et les réparations avancés des installations de production et d'infrastructure dans le domaine de l'électricité - la solution proactive des problèmes d'entretien récurrents dans le domaine d'activité assigné - la création d'installations électriques ainsi que la réparation et le dépannage des moteurs, des instruments et des commandes - l'identification des écarts et la documentation/la communication de ceux-ci selon les procédures d'exploitation normalisées - l'orientation et le suivi des entrepreneurs dans les projets d'entretien et d'installation, de l'arrivée à la sortie de la production - le travail conformément à toutes les exigences internes pertinentes en matière de sécurité et de qualité - la participation à des activités d'amélioration continue - la mise en œuvre de tâches administratives sur ordinateur et dans SAP - l'utilisation du poste de base, tôt et tard ainsi que dans le service pikett week-end. En cas de goulots d'étranglement de capacité, votre profil professionnel - Formation professionnelle complète dans le secteur électronique (installateur électrique EFZ) ou un domaine spécialisé connexe ayant au moins 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle de préférence en production ou en exploitation d'usine - permis d'électricien d'entreprise selon le type. 13 NIV ou volonté d'obtenir ceci - Utilisation sûre des outils et de l'équipement à main pour l'installation, le démontage et l'essai d'équipement électronique - Capacité de dessiner/sketch des diagrammes électriques ainsi que des instructions simples pour l'écriture et la fourniture - Entraînement des compétences en langue allemande dans les mots et l'écriture, les compétences en anglais sont avantageuses - Permis de conduire valide (catégorie B, voiture) Quels avantages supplémentaires offrons-nous? - Possibilités intéressantes de développement et de formation - 40 heures semaine - Journées supplémentaires rémunérées - Caisses de retraite avantageuses Conditions - Réductions dans le restaurant du personnel - Activités sportives et de loisirs au Givaudan Sports Club (douches sur place) - Réductions dans la boutique des employés à Kemptthal - Plaquette de stationnement et de vélo gratuite de l'entreprise - Contrôles REKA et participation à la demi-taxe CFF - Couverture mondiale des accidents privés et choix hospitalier gratuit - Indemnités familiales et de formation supplémentaires Chez Givaudan, vous aidez à créer de délicieuses expériences de goût et de parfum qui enrichissent la vie des gens. Nous apprécions les différentes perspectives qui émergent de diverses cultures, origines et expériences. Toute personne – indépendamment de son appartenance ethnique, de son identité de genre, de son orientation sexuelle, de son âge, de son handicap, de sa culture, de sa religion ou de sa situation personnelle – est la bienvenue à Givaudan, un endroit où nous aimons tous être et grandir. Chaque partie de vous est un enrichissement pour notre monde. Rejoignez-nous et construisez un avenir meilleur avec nous.
